title: FINCOSMOS: An Open-World Evaluation Paradigm for Agents in Finance
abstract: arXiv:2611.07464v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language agents increasingly work for users on the open Web, and finance is where trusting them is hardest. The data must come from the Web, the strategy lives in the user's head, and correctness depends on time, so an agent can fail silently: a strategy the user never asked for, unverified data, or a backtest that uses the future yields a report as convincing as a correct one. Existing benchmarks close the world somewhere, fixing the task, the data, or the timeline, and thereby remove these failures instead of measuring them. We introduce FINCOSMOS, an open-world evaluation paradigm for agents doing financial work. A simulated user holds a hidden strategy sampled from a compositional grammar and reveals it only when asked. The agent receives no data, so it must acquire data from the Web, build its own backtest under a data cutoff, and deliver verifiable results. Grading needs no reference answer. Programs verify point-in-time correctnes

translated_title: FINCOSMOS：一个面向金融领域智能体的开放世界评估范式
translated_abstract: 语言智能体越来越多地在开放网络上为用户工作，而金融领域是对它们最难以信任的场景。数据必须来自网络，策略只存在于用户脑中，且正确性依赖于时间，因此智能体可能“无声地失败”：执行一个用户从未要求过的策略、使用未经核实的数据，或进行一次使用了未来信息的回测——这些都会产出一个与正确报告同样令人信服的报告。现有基准测试总会在某处封闭世界，固定任务、数据或时间线，从而消除了这些失败模式而非度量它们。我们提出FINCOSMOS，一个面向金融工作智能体的开放世界评估范式：模拟用户持有一个从组合文法中采样得到的隐藏策略，且仅在被询问时才透露；智能体不会获得任何数据，因此必须自行从网络获取数据、在数据截止日期约束下构建自己的回测，并交付可验证的结果。评分无需参考答案，程序可自动验证时点正确性。
tldr: FINCOSMOS提出了一个金融智能体的开放世界评估范式：模拟用户隐藏其投资策略，智能体必须自主从网络获取数据并构建防“未来函数”的回测，从而实现无需参考答案、程序可验证的评估。
en_tdlr: FINCOSMOS introduces an open-world evaluation paradigm for financial agents, where a simulated user withholds a hidden strategy and the agent must autonomously acquire web data and build point-in-time-correct backtests, enabling verifiable grading without reference answers.
